biotools.summary: Pyxis is a vendor-neutral desktop application for ion mobility spectrometry imaging (IMS-MSI) data analysis, supporting both untargeted and targeted analysis workflows. The software is designed to address the challenges of analyzing complex IM-MSI datasets.
